Chapter 1. Deploying Models部署模型

Running models within your own cluster becomes necessary when real data cannot leave it due to privacy laws or compliance requirements, or when you need greater control over model deployment and performance.

当真实数据因隐私法律或合规要求不能外传、或者你需要对模型部署与性能拥有更强控制力时，在自有集群内运行模型就变得必要。

There are many different models on the market; many of them are open source and freely available for commercial use. Hugging Face is the largest community where you can find not only models but also datasets and libraries. For a list of current open source large language models, see Chapter 2.

市面上模型众多，其中很多是开源的、可自由用于商业用途。Hugging Face 是最大的社区，你不仅能找到模型，还能找到数据集和库。当前开源大语言模型清单见第 2 章。

Regardless of where you obtained the model, whether it’s open source or not, there are aspects of deploying the model on Kubernetes that aren’t specific to the model itself. However, some aspects require careful analysis of the model to determine the best approach.

无论模型从何处获得、是否开源，在 Kubernetes 上部署模型都有一些与模型本身无关的共性环节；但也有一些方面需要仔细分析模型才能确定最佳做法。

This chapter describes different approaches and patterns for managing the lifecycle of your model at runtime, with a focus on some of the most-used runtimes for LLMs. Before diving into deployment details, see the following sidebar for background on the Transformer architecture that powers most modern LLMs.

本章介绍在运行时管理模型生命周期的不同思路与模式，重点介绍最常用的几种 LLM 运行时。在深入部署细节之前，先看下面的侧栏，了解支撑大多数现代 LLM 的 Transformer 架构背景。

原书第 41 页

Sidebar: Transformer Architecture and Attention Mechanism

Generative AI is a vast field, and the maturity levels of different model classes vary significantly, with text generation models being the most widely used and optimized. Modern LLMs are predominantly based on Transformer architecture or a derivative (like the mixture of expert approach), although Transformers are also used beyond text for vision and multimodal tasks. These models can cover multiple use cases that involve text processing: chatbot, code generation, translation, summarization, etc.

生成式 AI 是一个广阔领域，各类模型的成熟度差异很大，其中文本生成模型使用最广、优化最充分。现代 LLM 主要基于 Transformer 架构或其衍生（如混合专家 MoE 方法），不过 Transformer 也用于文本之外的视觉与多模态任务。这类模型可覆盖多种涉及文本处理的用例：聊天机器人、代码生成、翻译、摘要等。

Transformer architecture is a deep learning architecture created and introduced by Google in 2017 to be more efficient in long-range dependencies tracking via Attention mechanisms. The main advantage of this architecture, compared to others like recurrent neural networks (RNNs), is that it doesn’t have recurring units. This means it doesn’t use the output of one neuron as the input to another. This makes it highly parallelizable during training.

Transformer 架构是 Google 于 2017 年提出的一种深度学习架构，旨在通过注意力机制更高效地追踪长程依赖。与循环神经网络（RNN）等其他架构相比，它的主要优势在于没有循环单元，即不把一个神经元的输出当作另一个神经元的输入，这使其在训练时可高度并行。

Long-range dependency is a core concept in natural language processing: the meaning of a sentence is influenced by the context.

长程依赖是自然语言处理中的一个核心概念：一个句子的含义会受到上下文影响。

The attention mechanism mimics human attention by assigning different weights (or importance) to various components of a sentence. In particular, a multihead attention mechanism runs an attention mechanism in parallel several times to produce different outputs that are then finally concatenated and linearly transformed.

注意力机制模仿人类注意力，给句子的不同成分分配不同权重（即重要性）。具体来说，多头注意力机制并行执行多次注意力，产生不同输出，再把它们拼接起来并做线性变换。

For more information on Transformer architecture and attention, see the article “How do Transformers work?”.

有关 Transformer 架构与注意力的更多信息，参见文章《How do Transformers work?》。

“It Works on My Machine”
“在我机器上能跑”

Before we explore deploying models on Kubernetes clusters, let’s first understand how to run a model locally on your machine.

在探讨把模型部署到 Kubernetes 集群之前，先看看如何在本机上运行一个模型。

In a nutshell, deploying a model requires both the model itself and a runtime capable of loading and executing it. As mentioned, Transformer-based models are the most common LLMs. Therefore, you can use the Transformers library from Hugging Face to load the model and invoke it. This doesn’t mean that every laptop can handle similar workloads, nor that models of every size can be loaded. It’s possible to execute some models using CPU with very limited performance (tens of seconds to produce a full sentence). However, a GPU is essentially required. Moreover, memory requirements are directly related to the size of the model. A model with 7 billion parameters (aka 7B) is considered a small language model (SLM) and requires a GPU with about 15 GB of memory to be loaded. A 70B model requires about 140 GB of memory.

简而言之，部署模型既需要模型本身，也需要一个能加载并执行它的运行时。如前所述，基于 Transformer 的模型是最常见的 LLM，因此你可以用 Hugging Face 的 Transformers 库来加载并调用模型。这并不意味着每台笔记本都能扛住这类工作负载，也不是说任意规模的模型都能加载。用 CPU 跑某些模型虽然可行，但性能非常有限（生成一整句要几十秒）；GPU 几乎是必需的。此外，显存需求与模型规模直接相关。一个 70 亿参数（即 7B）的模型算小型语言模型（SLM），加载它需要一块约 15 GB 显存的 GPU；而 70B 模型约需 140 GB 显存。

See Example 1-1 for a code example that illustrates this approach.

例 1-1 给出了演示这种做法的代码示例。

原书第 42 页

Example 1-1. Load and execute Llama 3 1B using Transformers

import transformers
import torch
import os

model_id = "meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct"

pipeline = transformers.pipeline(
    "text-generation",
    model=model_id,
    device_map="auto",
    torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    token=os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN")
)

messages = [
    {"role": "user", "content": "Hey how are you doing today?"}
]

result = pipeline(messages, max_new_tokens=256)
print(result[0]["generated_text"][-1]["content"])
  • The model identifier in Hugging Face format.Hugging Face 格式的模型标识符（model_id）。
  • Load and initialize the model.加载并初始化模型（pipeline）。
  • Use bfloat16 precision for better performance and memory efficiency.使用 bfloat16 精度以兼顾性能与显存效率。
  • Some models require a Hugging Face token to authorize the download. Get your token from your Hugging Face profile settings.部分模型需要 Hugging Face token 授权下载；可在你的 Hugging Face 个人设置中获取 token。
  • Extract and print only the assistant’s response from the result.从结果中只取出助手回复并打印。

While this example demonstrates the basic mechanics of loading and running a model, it has limitations for real-world use. The prompt is hardcoded, and there’s no way for users to interact with the model. To make this practical, we need to accept user input and expose the model through an endpoint that can handle multiple requests.

这个例子演示了加载与运行模型的基本机制，但离真实使用还有局限：prompt 是硬编码的，用户无法与模型交互。要让它实用起来，我们需要接受用户输入，并通过一个能处理多请求的端点把模型暴露出去。

Revisiting Example 1-1, we can make it more flexible by accepting the prompt via an endpoint to make it more similar to a real-world scenario. The easiest improvement is to avoid downloading the model on the fly every time runtime is started. The pattern to download and initialize the model is quite common during the development and experimentation phase, but it is possible, and usually suggested, to make the model available to the cluster without the need to access internet. There are different file formats, storage options, and loading techniques; see Chapter 2 for more information.

改造例 1-1，可以通过端点接收 prompt，使其更接近真实场景。最直接的改进是：不要每次启动运行时都临时下载模型。边开发边试验时，临时下载并初始化模型很常见；但完全可以、通常也建议让模型在集群内即可获取而无需联网。文件格式、存储方式与加载技术有多种，详见第 2 章。

原书第 43 页

The next step is to expose the model with an endpoint so that the prompt is dynamic and multiple users can invoke it. One simple way to do this is to use Python’s ecosystem, in particular, FastAPI and Pydantic. See Example 1-2.

下一步是用端点暴露模型，让 prompt 动态化、支持多用户调用。一个简单做法是借助 Python 生态，尤其是 FastAPI 与 Pydantic，见例 1-2。

Example 1-2. FastAPI generate endpoint

from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import transformers

app = FastAPI()

class InputText(BaseModel):
    text: str

class OutputText(BaseModel):
    text: str

def get_pipeline():
    model_id = "meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct"
    return transformers.pipeline(
        "text-generation",
        model=model_id,
        device_map="auto"
    )

pipeline = get_pipeline()

@app.post("/generate", response_model=OutputText)
async def generate_func(prompt: InputText):
    output = pipeline(prompt.text)
    return {"text": output[0]["generated_text"]}

Creating a container image and deploying it on Kubernetes is possible, but production workloads require more consideration. Scalability, throughput, reproducibility, and monitoring are critical for production deployments.

把它打成容器镜像并部署到 Kubernetes 当然可行，但生产负载需要更多考量：可扩展性、吞吐量、可复现性和监控对生产部署都至关重要。

At the same time, the example isn’t really model-specific. This suggests we’re already creating something generic that might be generalized even more. Essentially, we’re recreating a model server.

同时，这个例子其实并不针对某个具体模型。这说明我们已经在造一个通用的东西，而且还能进一步通用化——本质上，我们是在重新实现一个模型服务器。

Model Server
模型服务器

A model server (or serving runtime) is a component that includes one or more runtimes. It can be distributed to use multiple GPUs simultaneously and execute various types of models. The models are exposed via an API (REST or gRPC) and optimized to maximize throughput and minimize latency (Figure 1-1).

模型服务器（或称 serving 运行时）是一个内含一个或多个运行时的组件。它可以分布式地同时使用多块 GPU、执行各类模型，并通过 API（REST 或 gRPC）对外暴露模型，同时优化以最大化吞吐、最小化延迟（图 1-1）。

原书第 44 页

This concept is not new or specific to generative AI. Multiple existing model servers use common frameworks to serve any type of traditional machine learning model for tasks like classification and regression, collectively known as predictive AI. Some of them are also evolving to support generative AI. Even if the concept is the same, the exposed API is very different. In predictive AI, the endpoint is usually a generic /predict or /infer because the model acts as a black box function. In generative AI, it’s a more task-oriented API because similar models can perform different types of actions and work with different types of modalities (see “Multimodal Models” on page 8): text generation, summarization, classification, text to image, etc.

这个概念并不新鲜，也非生成式 AI 独有。已有许多模型服务器用通用框架服务于分类、回归等各类传统机器学习模型（统称预测式 AI），其中一些也在演进以支持生成式 AI。即便概念相同，对外暴露的 API 也大不相同。预测式 AI 的端点通常是通用的 /predict 或 /infer，因为模型像一个黑盒函数；而生成式 AI 的 API 更面向具体任务，因为同类模型可执行不同类型的动作、处理不同模态（见第 8 页“多模态模型”）：文本生成、摘要、分类、文生图等。

Sidebar: API standardization

Model servers expose the AI model via an API that clients have to use. This API can be specific for a particular model server implementation, breaking the abstraction that the model server aims to provide because client applications should not be tied to a specific implementation.

模型服务器通过一个客户端必须使用的 API 来暴露 AI 模型。这个 API 可能与某种特定模型服务器实现绑定，从而破坏模型服务器本想提供的抽象——因为客户端应用不应被钉死在某个具体实现上。

This problem is not new or specific to generative AI. For predictive AI, the KServe open-inference-protocol (OIP) defines a specification to standardize “infer” endpoints. Most model servers have adopted it and it’s now expanding to include generative AI.

这个问题并不新鲜，也非生成式 AI 独有。在预测式 AI 领域，KServe 的开放推理协议（OIP）定义了一套规范来标准化“infer”端点，多数模型服务器已采用，如今正扩展到生成式 AI。

The API to invoke generative AI models is still experimental overall and very different based on the type of model and the task it performs. OpenAI with the Chat Completions API for chat completion is a de facto standard for text generation models.

调用生成式 AI 模型的 API 总体仍在实验阶段，且因模型类型与任务而大不相同。OpenAI 用于聊天补全的 Chat Completions API 已是文本生成模型的事实标准。

原书第 45 页

From a Kubernetes platform perspective, every model server is usually similar in terms of deployment topology. However, you should be aware of the type of model and task because the scaling, hardware optimization, and metrics to observe are model server-specific. We’ll delve more into this content in Chapter 5.

从 Kubernetes 平台视角看，各模型服务器在部署拓扑上通常相似。但你要留意模型类型与任务，因为扩缩容、硬件优化和需观测的指标都与具体模型服务器相关。第 5 章会深入讨论这部分内容。

Sidebar: Multimodal Models

Many LLMs typically work with just one modality: input and output are text. Multimodal models are able to process a larger set of modality, like images, video, audio, mathematical equations, and so on. In particular, the main goal is to mix similar modality to perform tasks like text to image where the input is a textual query and the output is a generated image. It’s possible to do the opposite or to mix multiple modalities in the same query by providing an image and a query to return a new image or text.

许多 LLM 通常只处理一种模态：输入与输出都是文本。多模态模型能处理更大范围的模态，如图像、视频、音频、数学公式等。其主要目标是混合不同模态来完成任务，比如文生图——输入文本查询、输出生成的图像；也可以反过来，或在同一查询中混合多种模态，例如给出一张图像加一个问题，返回新的图像或文本。

From a model architecture perspective, while many popular image/audio generation models use diffusion-based architectures (like Stable Diffusion), others use Transformer architectures (like DALL-E, Imagen, and AudioLM). This category of models is part of the generative AI space, but it’s not an LLM. While increasingly adopted across multiple industries, including healthcare, ecommerce, and content creation, there’s less standardization around them compared to text generation models. They’re often integrated into specialized products like image editors and chat interfaces.

从模型架构看，许多流行的图像/音频生成模型采用扩散架构（如 Stable Diffusion），另一些则采用 Transformer 架构（如 DALL-E、Imagen、AudioLM）。这类模型属于生成式 AI 范畴，但不是 LLM。尽管它们在医疗、电商、内容创作等行业采用越来越广，与文本生成模型相比标准化程度较低，常被集成进图像编辑器、聊天界面等专用产品中。

We assume in this book the usage of the LLM Transformer bases that are applicable to a larger set of use cases. This implies that the model output is text, but it doesn’t prevent the input from including images and audio together with text, making them multimodal models.

本书默认讨论适用面更广的 LLM Transformer 基座。这意味着模型输出是文本，但并不妨碍输入在文本之外附带图像与音频——使其成为多模态模型。

Now that we understand what a model server is, let’s examine specific implementations. We’ll explore several popular LLM model servers, including vLLM, TGI, llama.cpp, and NVIDIA NIM, highlighting their strengths and use cases.

理解了模型服务器是什么之后，让我们看看具体实现。我们将探讨几种流行的 LLM 模型服务器，包括 vLLM、TGI、llama.cpp 和 NVIDIA NIM，并指出它们的优势与适用场景。

vLLM

vLLM is a Linux Foundation AI & Data project for LLM inference and serving. The project is very active, with thousands of forks, hundreds of contributors, the support of more than fifty model architectures, end-to-end optimization techniques, and the support of multiple hardware vendors. It is a library that can be directly used in Python (Example 1-3), but the project includes a CLI and an OpenAI-compatible server.

vLLM 是 Linux Foundation AI & Data 旗下的 LLM 推理与服务项目，非常活跃：数千个 fork、数百贡献者、支持 50 多种模型架构、端到端优化技术，并兼容多家硬件厂商。它既可作为 Python 库直接使用（例 1-3），也提供 CLI 和兼容 OpenAI 的服务器。

原书第 46 页

Example 1-3. Load a model in vLLM and execute inference

from vllm import LLM

# Load the model
llm = LLM(model="meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B")
# Invoke the model
results = llm.generate("LLMs are great for")

# Extract the result
print(results[0].outputs[0].text)

Our goal is to serve the model on Kubernetes, so vLLM should be run in a container, making a server the best option. Starting the server requires minimal configuration. However, a key difference to note is that in a production Kubernetes environment, you will likely use a local copy of the model rather than fetching it on the fly from Hugging Face. You’ll need to specify the location of the local model to the server. See Example 1-4.

我们的目标是在 Kubernetes 上服务模型，因此 vLLM 应跑在容器里，服务器模式是最佳选择。启动服务器所需配置极少。但要注意一个关键差别：在生产 Kubernetes 环境中，你大概率使用本地模型副本，而非临时从 Hugging Face 拉取。你需要把本地模型的位置指定给服务器，见例 1-4。

Example 1-4. Start vLLM server and invoke via curl

# start the server
vllm serve \
 --port=8080 \
 --model=/mnt/models \
 --served-model-name=meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B

# invoke the model
curl http://localhost:8080/v1/completions \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{
  "model": "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B",
  "prompt": "LLMs are great for",
  "max_tokens": 10,
  "temperature": 0
 }'
  • Start the vLLM server.启动 vLLM 服务器。
  • Path to the directory containing the model (local to the container).包含模型的目录路径（容器内本地路径）。
  • Name of the model.模型名称。
  • Number of tokens the model should produce.模型应生成的 token 数量。
  • Temperature controls the randomness of the sampling, 0 makes the generation deterministic.temperature 控制采样随机性，设为 0 则生成结果确定。
原书第 47 页

From a Kubernetes platform perspective, many parameters are used to configure how the runtime loads and executes the model, but this is relatively transparent from a deployment standpoint. Optimizations such as PagedAttention, FlashAttention, and speculative decoding focus on efficient attention management and faster execution. While they don’t impact deployment directly, they do affect scalability and resource optimization.

从 Kubernetes 平台视角看，运行时有很多参数用于配置模型的加载与执行，但这在部署层面相对透明。PagedAttention、FlashAttention、投机解码等优化聚焦于高效的注意力管理与更快执行；它们不直接影响部署，但会影响可扩展性与资源优化。

For a deeper dive into these optimization techniques and their implications, see the following sidebar.

想更深入了解这些优化技术及其影响，见下面侧栏。

Sidebar: LLM Inference Optimization

The optimization of LLM execution is a rapidly evolving field with continuous advancements. Academia and engine implementation are closely coupled in this domain.

LLM 执行优化是一个快速演进、不断有新进展的领域。在这个方向上，学术界与推理引擎实现紧密结合。

New optimization techniques emerge frequently, and proper evaluation requires time to assess their practical benefits.

新的优化技术层出不穷，而恰当评估其实际收益需要时间。

In this scenario we already mentioned some key optimizations like PagedAttention and Flash Attention, which specifically make self-attention faster given the quadratic time and memory complexity of this phase when optimizing memory management.

前面已提到一些关键优化，如 PagedAttention 与 Flash Attention，它们在优化内存管理时专门加速自注意力——因为这一阶段的时间与内存复杂度是平方级的。

Another investment area is to reduce the size of the model minimizing performance loss using multiple quantization techniques; this reduces the floating point size of the weights of the model.

另一个投入方向是用多种量化技术在尽量不损失性能的前提下缩小模型体积；这会降低模型权重的浮点精度位数。

Beyond runtime optimizations, model distillation offers another path to faster inference by training a smaller “student” model to approximate a larger “teacher” model’s behavior. This model creation technique can reduce model size significantly while retaining much of the original capability.

除运行时优化外，模型蒸馏提供了另一条加速推理的路径：训练一个较小的“学生”模型去逼近较大“教师”模型的行为。这种模型创建技术可在保留大部分原有能力的同时显著缩小模型体积。

Speculative decoding is an optimization technique that leverages a two-model approach: a small, fast “draft” model predicts several tokens ahead, and the large model verifies those predictions in a single pass. By running the expensive large model less frequently while maintaining the same output quality, speculative decoding can improve throughput by 1.5 to 3 times, depending on how predictable the sequence is.

投机解码是一种优化技术，采用双模型思路：一个小而快的“草稿”模型提前预测若干 token，大模型再一次性验证这些预测。在保持输出质量不变的同时减少昂贵大模型的运行频次，投机解码可把吞吐提升 1.5 到 3 倍，具体取决于序列的可预测程度。

For more on model customization techniques, see Chapter 6.

有关模型定制技术的更多内容，见第 6 章。

There are many different ways to optimize the execution of an LLM. This book doesn’t aim to explain all of them. Fortunately, from an MLOps engineer perspective, you don’t need to be an expert in LLM optimization internals. Use a model server that is actively developed with a large community so that every new optimization is included. The configuration of vLLM, for example, is usually limited to changing the startup parameters of the runtime, and the project is getting better and better at automatically detecting, based on the model to execute, which configuration to apply so the default values will most likely work.

优化 LLM 执行的方式有很多，本书并不打算逐一解释。幸运的是，从 MLOps 工程师角度，你不必成为 LLM 优化内部机制的专家。选用一个社区活跃、持续开发的模型服务器即可，让每项新优化都被自动纳入。例如 vLLM 的配置通常只需调整运行时的启动参数；而且该项目越来越擅长根据要执行的模型自动检测该套用哪种配置，默认值多半就能直接工作。

Some of the configuration, like quantization, has an effect on the quality of the model and the tuning to find the right trade-off. This is part of model development and tuning, so that at inference time you should already get the configuration as part of the deployment.

有些配置（如量化）会影响模型质量，需要调优以找到合适的折中。这属于模型开发与调优的范畴，因此到推理阶段，相关配置应当已作为部署的一部分就绪。

原书第 48 页

On the other hand, as an MLOps engineer you should be aware of the parameters that have a larger implication on parallelization and scaling: multinode distributed serving has an impact on overall topology, it usually requires additional components to manage the coordination, and it makes the deployment stateful. We will discuss running the model in more detail in Chapter 4.

另一方面，作为 MLOps 工程师，你应当了解那些对并行化与扩缩容影响较大的参数：多节点分布式服务会影响整体拓扑，通常需要额外组件来管理协调，并使部署变成有状态的。我们将在第 4 章更详细地讨论模型运行。

Hugging Face Text Generation Inference

The Hugging Face text generation inference (TGI) is an open source model server implementation created to serve text generation models and is used to power its product offering. Hugging Face has been mentioned multiple times already because it is the most active community where you can share generative AI models (base or fine-tuned models) as well as datasets and libraries. Many of the most used libraries for generative AI, like transformers, peft, or diffusers, are incubated in this community.

Hugging Face 的文本生成推理（TGI）是一个开源模型服务器实现，用于服务文本生成模型，并支撑 Hugging Face 自家产品。我们已多次提到 Hugging Face，因为它是最活跃的社区，你可以在那里分享生成式 AI 模型（基座模型或微调模型）以及数据集和库。生成式 AI 最常用的许多库，如 transformers、peft、diffusers，都孵化于这个社区。

TGI now supports multiple inference backends, allowing you to choose the most appropriate backend for your hardware and performance requirements while maintaining a consistent API. Supported backends include TGI’s native CUDA backend (optimized for NVIDIA GPUs), NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp (for CPU deployment), and AWS Neuron (for AWS Trainium and Inferentia chips). Multi-backend support is an emerging trend in model servers, with projects like Triton and TGI adopting this approach to provide flexibility in deployment options. While the main advantage is the ability to select the optimal backend for your specific hardware and use case, there is a trade-off: even though backends are exposed through a unified API (such as OpenAI-compatible endpoints), the configuration parameters and tuning options vary significantly across backends. This can complicate optimization and debugging when you need to switch between backends or fine-tune performance.

TGI 现在支持多种推理后端，让你在保持一致 API 的同时，为自己的硬件与性能需求选择最合适的后端。支持的后端包括 TGI 原生 CUDA 后端（为 NVIDIA GPU 优化）、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM、llama.cpp（用于 CPU 部署）以及 AWS Neuron（用于 AWS Trainium 与 Inferentia 芯片）。多后端支持是模型服务器的新趋势，Triton、TGI 等项目都采用这种方式以提供部署灵活性。主要优势是能为特定硬件与用例选最优后端，但也有代价：尽管各后端都通过统一 API（如兼容 OpenAI 的端点）暴露，配置参数与调优项却差异很大，当你需要在后端间切换或精细调优性能时，会让优化与排错变复杂。

Similar to vLLM, TGI has a launcher that can be used to start the server and load the model. See Example 1-5.

与 vLLM 类似，TGI 提供一个 launcher，可用于启动服务器并加载模型，见例 1-5。

原书第 49 页

Example 1-5. Start the TGI server with native and OpenAI APIs

# start the server
text-generation-launcher \
 --port 8080 \
 --model-id /mnt/models

# invoke the model using TGI API
 curl localhost:8080/generate_stream \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -X POST \
    -d '{"inputs":"LLMs are great for",
     "parameters":{"max_new_tokens":10}
     }'

# invoke the model using OpenAI-compatible API
curl localhost:3000/v1/chat/completions \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -X POST \
    -d '{
  "model": "tgi",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "LLMs are great for"}
  ],
  "max_tokens": 10
}'
  • Launcher command.launcher 启动命令。
  • Path to the directory containing the model (local to the container).包含模型的目录路径（容器内本地路径）。
  • TGI original API to invoke the model.TGI 原生的模型调用 API。
  • TGI now also supports an OpenAI-compatible API.TGI 现在也支持兼容 OpenAI 的 API。
  • One of the most common categories of fine-tuned models is “instruct” models, designed to follow human instructions. In this scenario, the system prompt defines the role of the model.微调模型中最常见的一类是“instruct”模型，旨在遵循人类指令；在这种场景下，系统 prompt 定义模型扮演的角色。

The comments about the parameters and their implications for Kubernetes apply to TGI as well.

关于参数及其对 Kubernetes 影响的说明同样适用于 TGI。

Beyond vLLM and TGI, several other model servers deserve attention for specific use cases.

除 vLLM 和 TGI 外，还有一些模型服务器值得在特定用例下关注。

Other Model Servers
其他模型服务器

While vLLM and TGI are commonly used open source model servers for LLMs, other implementations deserve consideration for specific deployment scenarios and hardware configurations.

虽然 vLLM 与 TGI 是常用的开源 LLM 模型服务器，但在特定部署场景与硬件配置下，其他实现也值得考虑。

llama.cpp

llama.cpp is a C++ implementation that runs Llama models. It was originally created as a full re-implementation of the Transformer architecture in C++ specifically for Llama models. Over time, it has evolved to support a variety of other models. The focus has been on efficiency, making it the recommended option for running similar models locally on a laptop. Although it still requires a powerful machine, it is widely used by projects such as Ollama, Ramalama, and LM Studio. While it is not designed for large-scale production deployments with high concurrency, llama.cpp excels in resource-constrained environments. An active community continues to port optimizations and techniques from other model servers to C++, making llama.cpp increasingly powerful for edge scenarios such as on-device inference and local development. One result of llama.cpp’s development is the creation of the GGUF file format, which other libraries have now adopted.

llama.cpp 是一个运行 Llama 模型的 C++ 实现。它最初是专门为 Llama 模型用 C++ 对 Transformer 架构做的完整重写，后来逐渐演进到支持多种其他模型。它专注于效率，是在笔记本上本地运行同类模型的推荐选择。虽然仍需要一台性能不错的机器，但它被 Ollama、Ramalama、LM Studio 等项目广泛使用。它并非为大规模、高并发生产部署设计，却在资源受限环境中表现出色。活跃社区持续把其他模型服务器的优化与技术移植到 C++，让 llama.cpp 在端侧推理、本地开发等边缘场景中越来越强。llama.cpp 发展的一个成果是创造了 GGUF 文件格式，现已被其他库采用。

In addition to the core library, there is a Python server that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API similar to the other model servers; see Example 1-6.

除核心库外，它还有一个 Python 服务器，像其他模型服务器一样暴露兼容 OpenAI 的 API；见例 1-6。

Example 1-6. Start the llama.cpp Python server

python -m llama_cpp.server \
 --model /mnt/models
  • Start the llama.cpp server.启动 llama.cpp 服务器。
  • Location of the model (local to the container).模型位置（容器内本地路径）。
原书第 51 页

Sidebar: Local tools built on llama.cpp

Assuming you have a powerful machine with at least 24 GB of memory, but even without GPU, running quantized LLMs locally is remarkably straightforward using tools built on top of llama.cpp.

假设你有一台内存至少 24 GB 的性能不错的机器；即便没有 GPU，用基于 llama.cpp 构建的工具在本地跑量化 LLM 也非常简单。

Ollama provides a simple CLI interface to download and run models with a single command: ollama run llama3.2:3b

Ollama 提供简洁的 CLI，一条命令即可下载并运行模型：ollama run llama3.2:3b

Ramalama offers similar simplicity with support for multiple model registries and container runtimes: ramalama run llama3.2:3b

Ramalama 同样简洁，并支持多个模型仓库与容器运行时：ramalama run llama3.2:3b

Both tools use llama.cpp behind the scenes to handle model execution and expose an OpenAI-compatible API for inference. While Ramalama provides stronger isolation through container-based execution, Ollama offers a more polished developer experience with easier model management. Both are ideal for local development, experimentation, and prototyping before deploying to production Kubernetes clusters.

这两个工具底层都用 llama.cpp 处理模型执行，并暴露兼容 OpenAI 的推理 API。Ramalama 通过基于容器的执行提供更强隔离，Ollama 则以更完善的模型管理带来更顺滑的开发者体验。两者都非常适合在部署到生产 Kubernetes 集群之前做本地开发、试验与原型验证。

NVIDIA NIM

NVIDIA is the leading provider of GPU for AI and also provides the necessary software to train and serve models. NVIDIA NIM is a solution designed for Kubernetes to simplify the deployment and optimization of an LLM on NVIDIA hardware. It takes a different approach with a curated container image per model family, where models are directly tested and published by NVIDIA. Check the supported model list (like Llama and Mistral) in the documentation. This approach aims to simplify the deployment configuration having pre-optimized model profiles.

NVIDIA 是 AI GPU 的领先供应商，也提供训练与服务模型所需的软件。NVIDIA NIM 是一个面向 Kubernetes 的解决方案，旨在简化 LLM 在 NVIDIA 硬件上的部署与优化。它采用不同思路：为每个模型家族提供精选容器镜像，模型由 NVIDIA 直接测试并发布。支持的模型清单（如 Llama、Mistral）见文档。这种思路通过预置优化的模型配置来简化部署配置。

Similar to TGI, NVIDIA NIM supports multiple inference backends: TensorRT-LLM (an open source library for optimizing LLM inference on NVIDIA GPUs), vLLM, and SGLang. NIM automatically selects the optimal backend based on available model profiles for the detected GPU hardware, with a preference order of TensorRT-LLM > vLLM > SGLang. The selection is automatic based on the availability of pre-optimized TensorRT engines and other parameters. This hardware-aware backend selection allows users to benefit from the most suitable inference engine without manual configuration.

与 TGI 类似，NVIDIA NIM 支持多种推理后端：TensorRT-LLM（在 NVIDIA GPU 上优化 LLM 推理的开源库）、vLLM 和 SGLang。NIM 会根据探测到的 GPU 硬件上可用的模型配置自动选择最优后端，优先级为 TensorRT-LLM > vLLM > SGLang。选择基于预优化 TensorRT 引擎的可用性及其他参数自动完成。这种硬件感知的后端选择让用户无需手动配置即可受益于最合适的推理引擎。

原书第 52 页

Beyond backend selection, NVIDIA NIM stands out due to its opinionated design offering some notable features: local caching of the model and hardware optimization. Local caching is supported by a PersistentVolume, aiming to simplify and speed up one of the major pain points of model serving for LLMs: loading time. The model is downloaded only once, and subsequent replica creations or restarts do not trigger another download. Hardware optimization is another key feature: NVIDIA NIM can detect available accelerators, select the most suitable model variant for the configuration, and adjust the model server settings accordingly. See Figure 1-2 for more details on NVIDIA NIM architecture.

除后端选择外，NVIDIA NIM 还以其鲜明的设计理念著称，提供两个值得注意的特性：模型本地缓存与硬件优化。本地缓存借助 PersistentVolume，旨在简化并加速 LLM 模型服务的主要痛点之一——加载时间。模型只下载一次，后续创建副本或重启都不会再次下载。硬件优化是另一个关键特性：NVIDIA NIM 能探测可用加速器、为当前配置选择最合适的模型变体，并相应调整模型服务器设置。NVIDIA NIM 架构详见图 1-2。

SGLang

SGLang is an open source high-performance serving framework for large language models and vision-language models, designed to deliver low-latency, high-throughput inference. The project has gained significant industry adoption and is notable for its advanced optimization techniques.

SGLang 是面向大语言模型与视觉-语言模型的开源高性能服务框架，旨在提供低延迟、高吞吐的推理。该项目已获得业界广泛采用，并以其先进的优化技术著称。

Many performance improvements have been driven by the SGLang project, for example, RadixAttention, a sophisticated caching mechanism that stores key-value (KV) caches in a radix tree structure. This enables efficient prefix search and cache reuse across requests, which is particularly beneficial for workloads with common prompt prefixes or multiturn conversations where previous context can be reused. SGLang supports continuous batching, speculative decoding, and various quantization techniques.

许多性能改进由 SGLang 项目推动，例如 RadixAttention——一种把键值（KV）缓存存储在基数树结构中的复杂缓存机制。这实现了高效的前缀检索与跨请求缓存复用，对有公共 prompt 前缀或多轮对话（可复用先前上下文）的工作负载尤其有利。SGLang 支持连续批处理、投机解码以及多种量化技术。

Like vLLM and TGI, SGLang exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and supports most LLM model architectures.

与 vLLM、TGI 一样，SGLang 暴露兼容 OpenAI 的 API，并支持大多数 LLM 模型架构。

Starting an SGLang server follows a similar pattern to other model servers. See Example 1-7 for an example.

启动 SGLang 服务器与其他模型服务器类似，示例见例 1-7。

原书第 53 页

Example 1-7. Start an SGLang server

python -m sglang.launch_server \
 --model-path /mnt/models \
 --port 8080
  • Launch the SGLang server.启动 SGLang 服务器。
  • Path to the model directory (local to the container).模型目录路径（容器内本地路径）。

SGLang is particularly well-suited for scenarios requiring high cache hit rates, such as agents making multiple calls with similar contexts, or applications with structured prompts where prefix reuse is common.

SGLang 特别适合需要高缓存命中率的场景，例如智能体以相似上下文多次调用，或结构化 prompt、前缀复用频繁的应用。

Deploying Models to Kubernetes Manually
手动部署模型到 Kubernetes

Now that we understand what model servers are and have explored several implementations specialized for LLMs, let’s deploy one to Kubernetes. We will start with a manual approach using standard Kubernetes resources to understand what is involved in production deployments.

理解了模型服务器是什么、也看了几种 LLM 专用实现之后，让我们把一个部署到 Kubernetes。先用标准 Kubernetes 资源手动部署，以看清生产部署涉及哪些环节。

This DIY (Do It Yourself) approach is always available and sometimes necessary if you need to customize every aspect of the deployment, even in a controller environment.

这种 DIY（自己动手）方式始终可行；当你需要定制部署的方方面面时（即便在控制器环境里），它有时也是必要的。

Let’s assume you want to use vLLM and you already have the image to use. In Example 1-8 you can easily spot most of the configuration that you need to consider in your deployment: port to expose, path where the model is, and the GPU configuration and parameters to execute the model that are essentially model-specific.

假设你想用 vLLM 且已有可用镜像。在例 1-8 中可以轻易看到部署时需要考虑的大部分配置：要暴露的端口、模型所在路径，以及本质上与模型相关的 GPU 配置与执行参数。

Example 1-8. Start a vLLM server with GPU

# specify which of the available GPUs to use
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1
vllm serve \
 --port=8080 \
 --model=/mnt/models \
 --served-model-name=meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B

Now that we know how to create a deployment, the name of the model we want to use, and the GPU requirements, we are ready to proceed. See Example 1-9 for the full deployment spec (with PersistentVolumeClaim) to apply to your cluster.

知道了如何创建 deployment、要用的模型名以及 GPU 需求后，我们就可以继续了。例 1-9 给出可直接应用到集群的完整 deployment 清单（含 PersistentVolumeClaim）。

原书第 54 页

Example 1-9. Deploy the vLLM server with GPU

kind: Deployment
apiVersion: apps/v1
metadata:
  name: vllm
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - resources:
            limits:
              cpu: '4'
              memory: 12Gi
              nvidia.com/gpu: '1'
            requests:
              cpu: '2'
          name: vllm
          env:
            - name: HF_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: huggingface-secret
                  key: token
          args: ["--port", "8080", "--model",
                 "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B",
                 "--download-dir", "/models-cache"]
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          volumeMounts:
            - name: models-cache
              mountPath: /models-cache
          image: vllm/vllm-openai:latest
      volumes:
        - name: models-cache
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: vllm-models-cache
      tolerations:
        - key: nvidia.com/gpu
          operator: Exists
          effect: NoSchedule
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: vllm-models-cache
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  volumeMode: Filesystem
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 100Gi
  • In addition to the traditional CPU and memory, you can specify the number of GPUs the model needs.除传统的 CPU、内存外，可以指定模型所需的 GPU 数量。
  • One option with vLLM is to download the model on the fly from Hugging Face, which requires injecting the token as an environment variable.vLLM 的一个选项是临时从 Hugging Face 下载模型，这需要通过环境变量注入 token。
  • The entrypoint of the vLLM image is already starting the server, so it is only necessary to specify the additional parameters.vLLM 镜像的入口已会启动服务器，只需追加额外参数。
  • When downloading on the fly, it is suggested to specify a persisted model cache where the model is stored.临时下载时，建议指定一个持久化的模型缓存目录来存放模型。
  • The port to expose (useful then to expose it via service and ingress).要暴露的端口（后续通过 service 和 ingress 暴露时有用）。
  • The persisted volume to use as the cache.用作缓存的持久卷。
  • Taints prevent non-GPU workloads from being scheduled on GPU nodes, while tolerations allow this GPU workload to be scheduled on those tainted nodes.污点（taint）阻止非 GPU 工作负载被调度到 GPU 节点，而容忍（toleration）则允许本 GPU 工作负载被调度到这些被打了污点的节点上。
原书第 55 页

This example does not cover GPU configuration in Kubernetes (more about this in Chapter 3), restart policies, scaling, or probes. It is also limited to scenarios where the model can be deployed to a single node and not the distributed serving scenario.

本例未涉及 Kubernetes 中的 GPU 配置（详见第 3 章）、重启策略、扩缩容或探针，也仅限模型可部署到单节点的场景，而非分布式服务场景。

While this manual approach works and is quite self-contained, it reveals significant complexity: GPU resource management, tolerations and taints, storage configuration, secrets management, and model-specific parameters all require explicit configuration. As you deploy multiple models with different requirements, this complexity multiplies. Each new model means another deployment manifest, another PVC, careful coordination of resource requests, and manual management of configuration changes.

手动方式虽可行且相当自包含，却暴露出大量复杂度：GPU 资源管理、容忍与污点、存储配置、密钥管理以及模型专属参数都要显式配置。当你部署多个需求各异的模型时，这种复杂度会成倍放大——每个新模型都意味着又一份 deployment 清单、又一个 PVC、又一轮资源请求的仔细协调，以及对配置变更的手工管理。

This is exactly why model server controllers exist to abstract this complexity behind higher-level APIs that focus on model deployment rather than low-level Kubernetes infrastructure details.

这正是模型服务器控制器存在的意义：把这些复杂度抽象到更高层 API 之后，让你专注于模型部署，而非底层 Kubernetes 基础设施细节。

原书第 56 页

Model Server Controller
模型服务器控制器

As we have seen in the manual deployment approach, deploying models to Kubernetes requires managing numerous resources: deployments, PersistentVolumeClaims, GPU configurations, tolerations, and model-specific parameters. Model server controllers simplify this complexity by providing higher-level abstractions through Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs).

正如手动部署方式所见，在 Kubernetes 上部署模型需要管理大量资源：deployment、PersistentVolumeClaim、GPU 配置、容忍和模型专属参数。模型服务器控制器通过自定义资源定义（CRD）提供更高层抽象来简化这种复杂度。

Instead of manually crafting deployment manifests and coordinating multiple Kubernetes resources, controllers allow you to declare your intent at a higher level. The CRD approach also provides centralized status information, making it easier to monitor the health and state of your model deployments. Figure 1-3 extends the previous model server architecture diagram to include the main controller components: one or more Kubernetes CustomResourceDefinition and a Kubernetes controller.

控制器让你不必手工编写 deployment 清单、协调多种 Kubernetes 资源，而是在更高层声明意图。CRD 方式还提供集中的状态信息，便于监控模型部署的健康状况与状态。图 1-3 在前面模型服务器架构图上补充了控制器的主要组件：一个或多个 Kubernetes 自定义资源定义，以及一个 Kubernetes 控制器。

Each model server usually provides the container images so that you do not need to build them; at the same time, picking the right container image is not straightforward: each accelerator has different drivers and frameworks (e.g., NVIDIA with CUDA, AMD with ROCm, etc.), so it is necessary to pay attention to this aspect. This concern is similar to multiarchitecture containers, where you can easily select the architecture (e.g., ARM64 or i386) and get the appropriate container version. However, for accelerators, the process is still quite manual. For more on how Kubernetes manages GPU and accelerator access through device plug-ins, see Chapter 3.

各模型服务器通常提供容器镜像，无需自行构建；但选对镜像并不容易——每种加速器有不同的驱动与框架（如 NVIDIA 配 CUDA、AMD 配 ROCm 等），必须留意这一点。这有点像多架构容器：你可以轻松选择架构（如 ARM64 或 i386）并拿到对应容器版本；但在加速器场景，这个过程仍相当手动。Kubernetes 如何通过设备插件管理 GPU 与加速器访问，详见第 3 章。

Let’s explore two popular model server controller approaches: KServe and Ray Serve.

下面看两种流行的模型服务器控制器方案：KServe 与 Ray Serve。

原书第 57 页

KServe

KServe is a Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) project that provides a model inference platform on Kubernetes designed to manage the lifecycle and wiring of model servers and models leveraging Kubernetes components to provide scalability, routing, canary rollout, density packing, and in general the possibility to expose a model inference endpoint.

KServe 是云原生计算基金会（CNCF）项目，在 Kubernetes 上提供模型推理平台，旨在管理模型服务器与模型的生命周期和接线，并借助 Kubernetes 组件提供扩缩容、路由、金丝雀发布、密度装箱，以及对外暴露模型推理端点的能力。

The project was originally created as KfServing within the Kubeflow community and later became an independent project (though it remains part of the Kubeflow ecosystem). The initial target has been predictive AI and only more recently evolved to include generative AI.

该项目最初作为 Kubeflow 社区内的 KfServing 创建，后来成为独立项目（不过仍属 Kubeflow 生态）。它早期面向预测式 AI，直到较近才演进到包含生成式 AI。

KServe is built as a Kubernetes native component extending Kubernetes API and providing multiple CustomResourceDefinitions to map the different concepts in a declarative way. We are not going to cover all of the API and concepts that KServe provides because most of them are still mainly applicable to predictive AI.

KServe 作为 Kubernetes 原生组件构建，扩展 Kubernetes API，并提供多个 CRD 以声明式地映射各种概念。我们不会逐一介绍 KServe 提供的所有 API 与概念，因为其中多数仍主要适用于预测式 AI。

From a technology stack perspective there are three different deployment modes: Knative, Standard, and ModelMesh (see Figure 1-4):

从技术栈看，有三种不同的部署模式：Knative、Standard 和 ModelMesh（见图 1-4）：

  • Knative: the most comprehensive stack, using Knative and Istio to manage autoscaling, rolling updates, traffic management, and composition (also via Knative Eventing). Using this mode, every model becomes a KnativeService.Knative：最完整的技术栈，用 Knative 与 Istio 管理自动扩缩容、滚动更新、流量管理与组合（也可通过 Knative Eventing）。在此模式下，每个模型都是一个 KnativeService。
  • Standard: the opposite of Knative, with no additional dependencies beyond what Kubernetes already provides. Using this mode, for every model, KServe creates a new deployment. KServe 0.16 introduces a new deployment approach via the LLMInferenceService CRD that is an evolution of the Standard deployment mode to manage advanced and scalable LLM deployments.Standard：与 Knative 相反，除 Kubernetes 本身提供的能力外不引入额外依赖。在此模式下，KServe 为每个模型创建一个新 deployment。KServe 0.16 通过 LLMInferenceService CRD 引入新的部署方式，是 Standard 模式的演进，用于管理高级、可扩展的 LLM 部署。
  • ModelMesh: the solution is specialized for high-density deployments where you need to deploy many models, potentially thousands, in the same cluster, and the footprint of using separate deployments is too large. In this mode the model server is dynamically loading and unloading models based on the requests.ModelMesh：专为高密度部署设计——你需要在同一集群部署许多（可能数千个）模型，而每个模型一个 deployment 的开销太大。在此模式下，模型服务器根据请求动态加载与卸载模型。

Sidebar: KServe naming

Starting with KServe 0.16, the deployment modes have been renamed for clarity:

从 KServe 0.16 起，部署模式为清晰起见更名如下：

  • Serverless is now Knative, which reflects the underlying technology (Knative Serving).Serverless 改称 Knative，反映底层技术（Knative Serving）。
  • RawDeployment is now Standard, a more intuitive name for standard Kubernetes deployments.RawDeployment 改称 Standard，对标准 Kubernetes deployment 来说更直观。
  • ModelMesh remains unchanged.ModelMesh 保持不变。

Throughout this book, we use the new terminology. If you’re using older KServe versions (pre 0.16), substitute “Knative” for “Serverless” and “Standard” for “RawDeployment.”

本书通篇采用新术语。如果你使用较旧的 KServe 版本（0.16 之前），请把“Serverless”理解为 Knative、把“RawDeployment”理解为 Standard。

原书第 59 页

The ModelMesh deployment mode is not really applicable to generative AI: the size and complexity of similar models doesn’t really give you the option to deploy multiples of them in the same node. On the other hand, the Knative and Standard deployment modes are generally applicable to generative AI. However, while smaller models such as Phi, Gemma, and Llama’s compact variants (sub-30B parameters) can run on consumer hardware and may benefit from dynamic scaling, larger production LLMs typically require dedicated GPU resources that are managed statically. This makes it challenging to fully use the dynamic autoscaling advantages of Knative mode. For the remainder of this section, we will assume Standard as the deployment mode.

ModelMesh 部署模式并不真正适用于生成式 AI：这类模型的规模与复杂性让你无法在同一节点上部署多个。另一方面，Knative 与 Standard 模式大体适用于生成式 AI。不过，像 Phi、Gemma 以及 Llama 的紧凑变体（30B 参数以下）这类较小模型可以跑在消费级硬件上、或许能受益于动态扩缩容；而大型生产 LLM 通常需要静态管理的专用 GPU 资源，这让充分发挥 Knative 模式的动态自动扩缩容优势变得困难。本节余下部分以 Standard 模式为准。

The two main APIs that KServe provides to deploy a model are ServingRuntime and InferenceService:

KServe 提供两个主要 API 来部署模型：ServingRuntime 与 InferenceService。

ServingRuntime

A ServingRuntime is equivalent to a pod template where a model server is declared. It specifies the image of the model server to use, along with some parameters and the type of model it can serve. This concept separates runtime configuration from model configuration. This separation gives project owners better control over model server versions, default configurations, and runtime lifecycle management. It is also possible to use a ClusterServingRuntime to configure a runtime that is available for the whole cluster. See Example 1-10.

ServingRuntime 相当于一个声明模型服务器的 pod 模板：指定要使用的模型服务器镜像、一些参数以及它能服务的模型类型。这个概念把运行时配置与模型配置分离，让项目负责人能更好地控制模型服务器版本、默认配置与运行时生命周期管理。也可以用 ClusterServingRuntime 配置一个全集群可用的运行时。见例 1-10。

Example 1-10. KServe ServingRuntime for vLLM

apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1alpha1
kind: ServingRuntime
metadata:
  name: vllm
spec:
  containers:
    - args: [--model, /mnt/models/, --port, "8080"]
      name: kserve-container
      image: vllm/vllm-openai:latest
      ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
          name: http1
          protocol: TCP
  multiModel: false
  supportedModelFormats:
    - autoSelect: true
      name: pytorch
  • Name of this custom ServingRuntime. KServe includes pre-configured ServingRuntimes (including one named “HuggingFace Runtime” that uses vLLM) that can be used directly. However, in this example we define our own custom vLLM ServingRuntime to have full control over the configuration and parameters.这个自定义 ServingRuntime 的名称。KServe 自带预配置的 ServingRuntime（包括一个名为“HuggingFace Runtime”、使用 vLLM 的），可直接使用；但本例中我们定义自己的 vLLM ServingRuntime，以完全掌控配置与参数。
  • This is the podSpec where it is possible to configure all the parameters necessary to run the model server.这是 podSpec，可在此配置运行模型服务器所需的全部参数。
  • This is the image that will be used. Note that applying this resource will not deploy the model server immediately but will make it available within the namespace for use.这是要使用的镜像。注意：应用此资源不会立刻部署模型服务器，而是让它在该命名空间内可用。
  • vLLM, like most of the model server, uses PyTorch as actual runtime for the model, so this configuration declares that this runtime is able to serve PyTorch models.vLLM 与多数模型服务器一样，底层用 PyTorch 作为模型运行时，因此此配置声明该运行时可服务 PyTorch 模型。
原书第 60 页

InferenceService

An InferenceService represents the model that the user wants to serve. This object can specify a ServingRuntime to use, or the selection can be automatic based on the model format. The creation of this resource will trigger the deployment of the model server and the wiring of the model. In the same spec it is possible to override the default parameters specified in the ServingRuntime and add more configuration that might be specific for the model. See Example 1-11.

InferenceService 代表用户想要服务的模型。该对象可以指定要使用的 ServingRuntime，也可根据模型格式自动选择。创建此资源会触发模型服务器部署与模型接线。在同一 spec 中可以覆盖 ServingRuntime 中指定的默认参数，并添加模型专属的额外配置。见例 1-11。

Example 1-11. InferenceService with Standard deployment mode

apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1beta1
kind: InferenceService
metadata:
  name: Meta-Llama-3-8B
  annotations:
    serving.kserve.io/deploymentMode: Standard
spec:
  predictor:
    model:
      modelFormat:
        name: pytorch
      runtime: vllm
      storageUri: pvc://llama/model
    containers:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpu: "4"
          memory: 50Gi
          nvidia.com/gpu: "1"
        requests:
          cpu: "1"
          memory: 50Gi
          nvidia.com/gpu: "1"
  • This annotation is to select the deployment mode.这个注解用于选择部署模式。
  • Declaring the type of model allows KServe to automatically find a ServingRuntime that can handle it.声明模型类型后，KServe 可自动找到能处理它的 ServingRuntime。
  • This field references the ServingRuntime by name, which provides the container image and configuration for the InferenceService.该字段按名称引用 ServingRuntime，为 InferenceService 提供容器镜像与配置。
  • This field specifies where to get the model, in this case from a PVC local to the cluster.该字段指定从哪里取模型，本例为集群本地的 PVC。
  • For each model, it is possible to override the resources to match the requirements of the model.可针对每个模型覆盖资源配置，以匹配模型需求。

Other concepts and APIs

KServe API is very flexible and includes many other concepts that are not strictly necessary to deploy an LLM but that enable more advanced and composable use cases. It is possible to configure an inference logger to forward every input and output of the model to a logger service for auditing or training purposes, do some preprocessing and postprocessing, or even compose different models using an InferenceGraph. See the KServe Control Plane API for a more comprehensive documentation.

KServe API 非常灵活，包含许多并非部署 LLM 严格必需、却能支持更高级、可组合用例的概念。你可以配置推理日志记录器，把模型的每次输入输出转发到日志服务用于审计或训练；可以做一些前后处理；甚至可以用 InferenceGraph 组合不同模型。更全面的文档见 KServe 控制平面 API。

One of the main benefits of the split between ServingRuntime and InferenceService is a more defined ownership in terms of management because the runtime lifecycle and model lifecycle are very different. KServe also provides additional benefits like the support of multiple storage options: the KServe controller injects an initContainer called storage initializer that reads the location of the model, performs the download (if necessary), and copies the model to a folder in the model server. It is also possible to replace the storage initializer container using the ClusterStorageContainer API with a custom one to support custom protocols for centralizing a catalog of available models. We will cover in more detail how to package, register, and load a model in Chapter 2.

ServingRuntime 与 InferenceService 分离的主要好处之一，是在管理上有更清晰的归属，因为运行时生命周期与模型生命周期非常不同。KServe 还提供其他便利，比如支持多种存储：KServe 控制器会注入一个名为 storage initializer 的 initContainer，它读取模型位置、（必要时）下载模型，并把模型复制到模型服务器中的某个目录。也可以用 ClusterStorageContainer API 替换这个 storage initializer 容器，换成自定义实现以支持自定义协议，从而集中管理可用模型目录。第 2 章会更详细地讲模型的打包、注册与加载。

KServe is actively evolving to provide better support for LLM-specific requirements through a new API surface (see the next section).

KServe 正在积极演进，通过新的 API 表面更好地支持 LLM 专属需求（见下一节）。

原书第 62 页

From InferenceService to LLMInferenceService

KServe 0.16 introduced a new LLMInferenceService CustomResourceDefinition specifically designed to manage complex and large-scale LLM deployments. While the traditional InferenceService API works for basic LLM serving, LLMInferenceService provides specialized capabilities for advanced deployment topologies that are common in production Generative AI workloads, including intelligent routing with KV cache-aware scheduling, disaggregated serving, and multinode distributed inference.

KServe 0.16 引入了新的 LLMInferenceService CRD，专门用于管理复杂、大规模的 LLM 部署。传统 InferenceService API 适用于基础 LLM 服务，而 LLMInferenceService 为生产级生成式 AI 工作负载中常见的高级部署拓扑提供专门能力，包括 KV 缓存感知调度的智能路由、解耦式服务和多节点分布式推理。

From an implementation perspective, LLMInferenceService uses the Standard deployment mode, creating plain Kubernetes Deployment resources, reflecting a fundamental shift in how LLM workloads are managed. This evolution requires rethinking traditional approaches to autoscaling and traffic management to address the unique characteristics of long-running GPU workloads where stability, resource predictability, and intelligent routing based on model state are more critical than rapid scaling.

从实现角度看，LLMInferenceService 使用 Standard 模式，创建普通的 Kubernetes Deployment 资源，反映了 LLM 工作负载管理方式的根本转变。这一演进要求重新思考传统的自动扩缩容与流量管理思路，以应对长时运行 GPU 工作负载的独特特性——在这些场景中，稳定性、资源可预测性以及基于模型状态的智能路由，比快速扩缩容更重要。

Example 1-12 shows an example configuration that highlights the key components and the relationship between LLMInferenceServiceConfig (which acts as a base template) and LLMInferenceService (which references the config and can override specific settings). The example demonstrates the router section with gateway and scheduler for intelligent routing, and parallelism settings for distributed inference across multiple GPUs.

例 1-12 给出一个配置示例，突出关键组件以及 LLMInferenceServiceConfig（作为基础模板）与 LLMInferenceService（引用该配置并可覆盖特定设置）之间的关系。示例展示了带 gateway 与 scheduler 的 router 部分（用于智能路由），以及跨多 GPU 分布式推理的并行度设置。

Table 1-1 compares the traditional InferenceService and ServingRuntime approach with the new LLMInferenceService and LLMInferenceServiceConfig APIs, highlighting the key differences in capabilities and use cases.

表 1-1 把传统的 InferenceService + ServingRuntime 方案与新的 LLMInferenceService + LLMInferenceServiceConfig API 做了对比，突出能力与适用场景的关键差异。

These features are particularly important for deploying very large models (70B+ parameters) that require multiple GPUs or sophisticated serving architectures. For more details on distributed inference patterns and techniques, see the llm-d project. We’ll cover disaggregated serving and advanced deployment topologies in detail in Chapter 4.

这些特性对部署需要多 GPU 或复杂服务架构的超大规模模型（70B+ 参数）尤为重要。分布式推理模式与技术详见 llm-d 项目；解耦式服务与高级部署拓扑将在第 4 章详细讨论。

原书第 63 页

Example 1-12. LLMInferenceService with distributed inference and base configuration

# Base configuration template
apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1alpha1
kind: LLMInferenceServiceConfig
metadata:
  name: vllm-llama-config
spec:
  template:
    containers:
      - name: kserve-container
        image: vllm/vllm-openai:latest
        args: ["--port=8080", "--model=/mnt/models"]
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: "1"
            cpu: "4"
            memory: 50Gi
  router:
    gateway: {}
    route: {}
    scheduler: {}
  parallelism:
    tensorParallelism: 2
---
# Actual LLM deployment
apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1alpha1
kind: LLMInferenceService
metadata:
  name: llama-3-8b
spec:
  baseRefs:
    - vllm-llama-config
  model:
    uri: pvc://llama/model
    name: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
  replicas: 3
  • vLLM container image and startup parameters for serving the model.用于服务模型的 vLLM 容器镜像与启动参数。
  • Router specification with gateway, route, and scheduler for intelligent routing with KV cache-aware scheduling.router 规范，含 gateway、route 与 scheduler，用于 KV 缓存感知的智能路由。
  • Parallelism strategies for distributed inference: tensor parallelism, data parallelism, and expert parallelism.分布式推理的并行策略：张量并行、数据并行与专家并行。
  • Reference to the base configuration template; multiple configs can be referenced, with the last one taking precedence.引用基础配置模板；可引用多个配置，后者优先生效。
  • Model specification defining the model source and characteristics.定义模型来源与特性的模型规范。
  • Number of replicas for horizontal scaling; this can override the base configuration.用于水平扩缩容的副本数；可覆盖基础配置。

原书第 64 页

While KServe takes a Kubernetes-native approach, Ray offers a different philosophy, one that prioritizes Python-first development and brings its own orchestration layer.

KServe 走的是 Kubernetes 原生路线，而 Ray 则代表另一种哲学：优先 Python 优先的开发，并自带一套编排层。

Ray Serve and KubeRay

The Ray project, compared to KServe, is a newer project with a broader scope. It is an open source framework designed to build and scale ML applications easily. It is very Pythonic, making it user-friendly for those with Python experience, and it allows you to configure all activities directly within your Python codebase.

与 KServe 相比，Ray 是一个更年轻、范围更广的项目。它是一个开源框架，旨在轻松构建和扩展 ML 应用。它非常 Pythonic，对有 Python 经验的人友好，让你直接在 Python 代码库里配置一切活动。

Ray is not specific for model serving but instead defines a set of core concepts that are quite generic: Task, Actor, Object, Placement Group, and Environment Dependency. These core concepts, in addition to the Ray Cluster, define the execution model that is used to build and scale all the other features. Figure 1-5 represents the topology of a Ray cluster with head node and worker nodes.

Ray 并不专门用于模型服务，而是定义了一组相当通用的核心概念：Task、Actor、Object、Placement Group 和环境依赖。这些核心概念加上 Ray Cluster，定义了用于构建和扩展其他所有特性的执行模型。图 1-5 展示了带 head 节点与 worker 节点的 Ray 集群拓扑。

If you need a more comprehensive foundation on Ray, we suggest Learning Ray by Max Pumperla et al. (O’Reilly, 2023).

若需要更全面的 Ray 基础，推荐 Max Pumperla 等人所著《Learning Ray》（O’Reilly, 2023）。

In Figure 1-5, you can see that a Ray Cluster wasn’t designed with Kubernetes in mind. It has a standalone infrastructure to manage the scheduling and orchestration of jobs that you can usually do with the Kubernetes API and the different worker nodes. There is the concept of a head node that acts as the entry point for the jobs that are then dispatched to one or more worker nodes where the execution will happen.

从图 1-5 可以看到，Ray 集群并非为 Kubernetes 设计。它有一套独立的基础设施来管理作业的调度与编排——而这些通常可以用 Kubernetes API 和不同 worker 节点来做。它有 head 节点的概念，作为作业入口，作业随后被分发到一个或多个 worker 节点执行。

原书第 65 页

The set of features that Ray offers covers most of the ML use cases; Ray Train, Ray Tune, and Ray Serve are just a subset of them. Ray Serve is the component that we need to use to serve a model, the deployment is defined in Python, and is the same for each endpoint to expose or model initialization. Example 1-13 is a very simplified scenario where a Transformer model is configured and deployed, similarly to the first section of this chapter. Given that it is configured directly in the code, Ray Serve is very flexible; you can easily find examples where it is integrated with FastAPI to expose the endpoint or using a library like vLLM to deploy a full model server.

Ray 提供的功能集覆盖大多数 ML 用例；Ray Train、Ray Tune、Ray Serve 只是其中一部分。Ray Serve 是我们用来服务模型的组件，部署在 Python 中定义，每个要暴露的端点或模型初始化都相同。例 1-13 是一个非常简化的场景：配置并部署一个 Transformer 模型，类似本章开头部分。由于直接在代码中配置，Ray Serve 非常灵活；你很容易找到它与 FastAPI 集成来暴露端点、或用 vLLM 之类库部署完整模型服务器的例子。

Example 1-13. Ray Serve with a Transformer-based model

from starlette.requests import Request
from typing import Dict
from transformers import pipeline
from ray import serve

@serve.deployment
class TransformerModelDeployment:
    def __init__(self):
        self._model = pipeline("my-transformer-model")

    def __call__(self, request: Request) -> Dict:
        return self._model(request.query_params["text"])[0]

serve.run(
    TransformerModelDeployment.bind(),
    route_prefix="/my-model/")
  • Decorator function where it is possible to configure most of the deployment aspects, like autoscaling.装饰器函数，可在此配置部署的大多数方面，如自动扩缩容。
  • The init method should be used to load a model, in this case it is a Transformer-based pipeline.init 方法应用于加载模型，本例中是一个基于 Transformer 的 pipeline。
  • This method deploys the model with a given prefix.该方法以给定前缀部署模型。
原书第 66 页

Ray has an API that is very friendly to a data scientist or a Python developer in general, but deploying a Ray Cluster on Kubernetes still requires help to wire all the components together with Kubernetes concepts like deployment and ingress.

Ray 的 API 对数据科学家或一般 Python 开发者非常友好，但在 Kubernetes 上部署 Ray 集群仍需借助外力，把各组件与 deployment、ingress 等 Kubernetes 概念接好。

The KubeRay project has been created to streamline the transition from local Ray execution to Kubernetes. This is necessary because Ray Clusters and Ray applications are not natively designed to use Kubernetes, in particular a Ray Cluster has a head node and worker nodes that need to be deployed with multiple deployments properly configured to interact with each other.

KubeRay 项目正是为简化从本地 Ray 执行迁移到 Kubernetes 而创建。这一步是必要的，因为 Ray 集群与 Ray 应用并非原生为使用 Kubernetes 而设计——特别是 Ray 集群有 head 节点和 worker 节点，需要用多个配置正确、彼此通信的 deployment 来部署。

KubeRay provides multiple Ray APIs as Kubernetes CustomResourceDefinition, but in particular the RayService object is a single concept that represents a multinode Ray Cluster and a Ray Serve application that uses that cluster. Example 1-14 is not a full example of the spec, but it highlights the main elements.

KubeRay 把多个 Ray API 提供为 Kubernetes CRD，其中 RayService 对象是一个统一概念，代表一个多节点 Ray 集群以及运行其上的 Ray Serve 应用。例 1-14 并非完整 spec 示例，而是突出主要元素。

原书第 67 页

Example 1-14. RayService CR snippet

apiVersion: ray.io/v1alpha1
kind: RayService
metadata:
  name: my-transformer-model
spec:
  serveConfigV2: |
    applications:
      - name: my-transformer-model
        import_path: my-transformer-model:deployment
        runtime_env:
          working_dir: "https://my-git-repo.com/main.zip"
  rayClusterConfig:
    rayVersion: %VERSION%
    headGroupSpec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: ray-head
            image: rayproject/ray-ml:%VERSION%
            ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
              name: serve
    workerGroupSpecs:
    - replicas: 1
      groupName: gpu-group
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: ray-worker
            image: rayproject/ray-ml:%VERSION%
          tolerations:
            - key: "ray.io/node-type"
              operator: "Equal"
              value: "worker"
              effect: "NoSchedule"
  • This field contains all the configuration of the Ray Serve application.该字段包含 Ray Serve 应用的全部配置。
  • The code of the application is downloaded from the working_dir location.应用代码从 working_dir 位置下载。
  • This section of the spec configures the head and worker nodes of Ray Cluster.spec 的这一部分配置 Ray 集群的 head 与 worker 节点。
  • The version of Ray should be specified here and in the images to use.Ray 版本应在此处及所用镜像中指定。
  • The head node exposes multiple components in addition to the serving aspect, like dashboard or client.head 节点除服务外还暴露多个组件，如 dashboard 或 client。
  • As in some previous examples, it is possible to configure tolerations and taints to match node requirements (such as GPUs or dedicated Ray nodes).与前面一些例子一样，可配置容忍与污点以匹配节点需求（如 GPU 或专用 Ray 节点）。
原书第 68 页

From a Kubernetes platform perspective, Ray is definitely less familiar in terms of API and management when compared to KServe, but at the same time it enables data scientists and Python developers to have full control over deployment. This flexibility brings a lot of value, especially when you need to configure a more complex serving topology, like distributed serving or training on multiple hosts.

从 Kubernetes 平台视角看，Ray 在 API 与运维上确实不如 KServe 熟悉，但它让数据科学家和 Python 开发者完全掌控部署。这种灵活性带来很大价值，尤其是当你需要配置更复杂的服务拓扑时，比如分布式服务或跨多主机训练。

Lessons Learned
本章小结

In this chapter we explored the components necessary to deploy LLMs on Kubernetes, from basic model serving to production-ready orchestration.

本章探讨了在 Kubernetes 上部署 LLM 所需的组件，从基础模型服务到生产级编排。

Model servers like vLLM, TGI, and SGLang provide essential optimizations (PagedAttention, FlashAttention, and continuous batching) that directly impact throughput and latency. While you can containerize inference code with FastAPI, production workloads demand specialized runtimes that maximize GPU utilization and efficiently manage memory-bound decode phases.

vLLM、TGI、SGLang 等模型服务器提供了直接影响吞吐与延迟的关键优化（PagedAttention、FlashAttention、连续批处理）。你固然可以用 FastAPI 把推理代码容器化，但生产负载需要专用运行时来最大化 GPU 利用率、高效管理内存密集的 decode 阶段。

The separation between serving runtime configuration and model lifecycle management reflects operational reality. KServe provides InferenceService with ServingRuntime for general model serving, and introduces LLMInferenceService with LLMInferenceServiceConfig for complex LLM deployments requiring distributed inference and advanced routing.

把服务运行时配置与模型生命周期管理分离，反映了运维现实。KServe 用 InferenceService + ServingRuntime 服务通用模型，并引入 LLMInferenceService + LLMInferenceServiceConfig 来应对需要分布式推理与高级路由的复杂 LLM 部署。

This separation acknowledges that runtime upgrades, model deployments, and infrastructure changes operate on different schedules with different ownership. Platform teams can manage runtime versions and container images, while data science teams deploy and iterate on models independently, preventing conflicts and enabling parallel workflows.

这种分离承认：运行时升级、模型部署与基础设施变更按不同节奏、由不同归属推进。平台团队管理运行时版本与容器镜像，数据团队独立部署和迭代模型，避免冲突、支持并行工作流。

Deployment controller choice involves fundamental trade-offs. KServe integrates natively with Kubernetes primitives (deployments, services, ingress), making it familiar to platform operators but requiring additional components for features like autoscaling. Ray provides a Python-first development experience with built-in distributed serving capabilities, but introduces its own orchestration layer that partially overlaps with Kubernetes, creating operational complexity when debugging or managing resources.

部署控制器的选择涉及根本权衡。KServe 原生对接 Kubernetes 原语（deployment、service、ingress），运维人员熟悉，但自动扩缩容等特性需要额外组件。Ray 提供 Python 优先的开发体验与内建分布式服务能力，但引入了与 Kubernetes 部分重叠的自有编排层，在排障或管理资源时带来运维复杂度。

Starting with manual deployments before adopting controllers remains valid for early-stage projects. Understanding the underlying deployment, PersistentVolumeClaim, and GPU resource configurations clarifies what controllers automate and helps diagnose issues when abstractions leak.

早期项目从手动部署起步、再采用控制器仍然合理。理解底层的 deployment、PersistentVolumeClaim 与 GPU 资源配置，能让你看清控制器到底自动化了什么，并在抽象泄漏时帮助排障。

With the inference infrastructure in place, one critical piece remains: the model itself.

推理基础设施就绪后，还剩关键一环：模型本身。

The next chapter tackles the challenge of managing model data and the strategies for getting it into your cluster efficiently.

下一章讨论模型数据管理的挑战，以及如何高效地把模型送进集群。
